sections.bio:
I build AI products people actually use and turn the process into high-performing technical content. From AI agents, LLMs, RAG, automation, and full-stack AI apps to real product experiments, I help brands showcase technology through authentic storytelling, not hype.

What I promise: fast execution, technically accurate content, real product demos, and founder-level ownership.

Formats: LinkedIn posts, X threads, technical tutorials, product demos, launch campaigns, demo videos, developer documentation, case studies, and AI workflow showcases.

Looking to collaborate with: AI startups, developer tools, SaaS platforms, open-source projects, cloud providers, productivity software, and brands building the future of AI.

posts.text:
One year ago, I thought this would take YEARS.

Today...

📈 100,000+ impressions
 👥 1,000+ followers

All from pressing one button...

Post.

The funny part?

Nobody was waiting for my first post.

Some got 20 views.
Some got almost no likes.

I wondered if anyone was even reading.

But I kept showing up.

At first...

- Once a week.
- Then twice a week.
- Then more consistently.

Slowly...

People started noticing.

Conversations started happening.

Opportunities started showing up.

The biggest lesson wasn't how to grow on LinkedIn.

It was this:

Nobody finds their voice before they start.

You find it by posting...

Again.

And again.

And again.

Even when it feels like nobody is watching.

If you're waiting for the perfect time...

This is it.

Hit Post today.

One year from now, you'll be glad you did.

#LinkedIn #SharingInPublic #ContentCreation #PersonalBrand #Consistency #BuildInPublic

Docker runs containers.
Kubernetes manages them at scale.
That's the biggest mindset shift I've had this week.

Learning how Pods, Master Nodes, and Worker Nodes work together finally made Kubernetes architecture click.

Following theory + hands-on with Abhishek Veeramalla.

Next step:
Building real projects.

I'll share everything I learn along the way.
#Kubernetes #Docker #DevOps

Fun Project : Live AI Video 🤯
I didn't expect Decart real-time AI video to be this good.
You make a frame with your fingers...

And AI generates a live world inside it at 30 FPS.

Move your hand? It follows.
Blink? It blinks.
Wave? It waves.

It feels less like a demo...
and more like the future.

Huge credit to Sophia Yang, Ph.D. for building this.

#AI #GenerativeAI #ComputerVision #WebRTC #RealTimeAI #OpenSource
